_help: Riddles for 'tell me a riddle'. q = the riddle, answers = words that count as a right guess (lower case), a = what she says if you give up.

riddles.q: I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish. What am I?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?
I'm always in front of you, but you can never see me. What am I?
What has a face and two hands but no arms or legs?
The more of me you have, the less you see. What am I?
I have keys but no locks, and space but no room. You can enter, but you can't go outside. What am I?
What can travel around the whole galaxy while staying in one corner?
I'm light as a feather, yet the strongest pilot can't hold me for more than a minute. What am I?
What gets bigger the more you take away from it?
I fly without wings and cry without eyes. Wherever I go, darkness follows. What am I?
What starts with an E, ends with an E, but only contains one letter?
